notes: The page examines S-hat-E as the preimage of the displayed Gamma inside S-double-hat-E, and then asks how the listed rho, sigma and tau elements lift. It records a multiplicative lift of the sign-graph subgroup Gamma_P* and a canonical homomorphism (11), followed by explicit tuple formulas (12). This is a summary of the manuscript, not an independent proof check.
The final paragraph changes sous-groupe to sous-ens. in its setup, then asserts that tuples whose three g entries equal 1 form a sous-groupe. Both the struck groupe and inserted ens. are retained.
The plus in Gamma+ is visibly different from the star in Gamma_P*. The transcription retains the visible plus and does not regularize it from surrounding notation.
The three short forms are barred m, not expanded même and not equality signs. The first and second ornate S forms remain alphabetically doubtful.

There are two separate canceled regions around the live rho. The unidentified region before rho is represented by an inline approximation of its visible geometry, supplied by the main reader after reviewing the crop; no letter is assigned. A separate comma follows live rho before the doubtful canceled tau.

The vertical strokes under the opening Gamma are parallel equality strokes. No rotated membership sign occurs there. The later horizontal relation before double-hatted Gamma is retraced, so subset versus membership is retained as an explicit doubt.

The period after canceled qui remonte is physically outside the cancellation. At the page end the low terminal may be a stop or part of the underline, so it remains doubtful. No separate stop is visible at the end of (12).

All original words, signs, indices, deletions and insertions were checked visually from the original and the two prepared halves. All seventeen first-pass crops were inspected. No OCR, external text, mathematical proof check, web source, or TeX compilation was used.
